# Ananda Crown Mohali

> An upcoming ultra-luxury residential high-rise development by Ananda Group, located in Sector 78, Mohali (SAS Nagar), Punjab. Target possession is scheduled for March 2028.

## Project Overview

* [Official Website](https://www.anandacrownmohali.com/): Primary landing page for project details, digital layouts, and media.
* [About the Developers](https://www.anandacrownmohali.com/overview): Profile on the Ananda Group leadership team, including founders Sahil Aggarwal and Anuj Bansal.
* [Amenities & Lifestyle](https://www.anandacrownmohali.com/): Features details on the 30,000 sq. ft. double-height clubhouse, rooftop infinity pool, yoga deck, and 80% open green landscapes.

## Configuration & Sizes

* [3 BHK Luxury Apartments](https://www.anandacrownmohali.com/blog): Premium layouts starting from 2,425 sq. ft.
* [3+1 BHK Premium Apartments](https://www.anandacrownmohali.com/blog): Layouts featuring an attached servant room/study, starting from 2,750 sq. ft.
* [4 BHK Sky Villas](https://www.anandacrownmohali.com/blog): Generous configurations with private lounges, starting from 3,250 sq. ft.
* [5 BHK Grand Residences](https://www.anandacrownmohali.com/blog): Ultra-premium flagship layouts scaling up to 4,100 sq. ft.

## Location & Connectivity

* **Address:** Sector 78, SAS Nagar, Mohali, Punjab 140308.
* **Proximity:** Strategically located right off the Airport Road (PR-7), offering instant connectivity to the Chandigarh International Airport (15-minute drive).
* **Surroundings:** Positioned within a 5 to 10-minute radius of the IT Park, Fortis Hospital, and major educational institutions like Amity University.
